subject: How can I use custom HTML attributes in Shiny?

messages.author: a60d28d0ae3bdda8
messages.subject: How can I use custom HTML attributes in Shiny?
parts:
Hi,
I'm trying to build a custom HTML input widget in my Shiny app, and I need to be able to pass a single value in to the javascript functions that govern the input's functionality.

When I developed an initial prototype as a pure HTML page (see attached) I defined the value as a custom HTML attribute "data-n-available-traps" (with the data- attribute name following the required custom attribute naming convention).

I now want to be able to set up the HTML within Shiny using the tags() function, but if I set up the div like this:

            tags$div(id = "availableTrapsBox",
                data-n-available-traps = "4"
            )

but this fails because R interprets the hyphens in "data-n-available-traps" as minus signs.

Is there a way to use HTML data- custom attributes within Shiny, so that I can then use the div.dataset.nAvailableTraps in the JavaScript code to get the value?

Thanks very much,

Louise

messages.subject: Re: How can I use custom HTML attributes in Shiny?
